chunks: And Zurārah ibn Aʿyan narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
There is no prayer on the day of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha except with a just Imam.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the leader under whom the prayer is to be performed
key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: Eid al-Adha, the festival associated with sacrifice during hajj
key_terms.الْفِطْرِ: Eid al-Fitr, the festival marking the end of sawm (fasting)
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: the ritual prayer being discussed here, specifically the Eid prayer
key_terms.عَادِلٍ: just and upright, describing the required Imam
key_terms.يَوْمَ: the specific day on which the ruling applies

ai.seo_question: Is the Eid prayer valid without a just Imam according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the salat of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. It states that this congregational Eid prayer is only established with the presence of a just Imam, indicating the importance of legitimate religious leadership in this act of worship.
